_template.title: Renewal or recertification reminder
_template.summary: Test the wording, timing, or channel of a reminder that a benefit is due for renewal.
_template.good_for: People losing coverage or benefits for paperwork reasons while still eligible (procedural churn).
_template.typical_change: Naming the deadline and the documents needed, sending earlier, or adding a second reminder.

experiment.name: Renewal reminder: name the deadline and documents
experiment.owner_team: FILL IN: which team owns renewal notices
experiment.description: FILL IN: the current reminder, the changed one, and why. Only the reminder changes; the renewal deadline, the required documents, and the renewal process stay the same.

hypothesis.statement: FILL IN: If the reminder <changes how>, more people will submit their renewal before the deadline, without more renewals being returned for missing information.

primary.name: renewal_submitted_rate
primary.definition: Share of people sent a renewal reminder who then submitted their renewal successfully, counted once per person.
